leads.title: Gender Recognition Act 2009 (c.11)
leads.documents: Allows transgender persons to change legal gender and have new gender recognised in Isle of Man
leads.detail: Cited in-text as Gender Recognition Act 2009 (c.11)

leads.title: Equality Act 2017
leads.documents: Lists gender reassignment, sexual orientation, sex, marriage and civil partnership among protected characteristics; defines sexual orientation; phased in from 1 Jan 2019
leads.detail: Cited in-text as Equality Act 2017 (Manx: Slattys Cormid 2017); Royal assent 18 July 2017; approved by House of Keys 7 March 2017

leads.title: Human Rights Act 2001
leads.documents: Incorporates European Convention on Human Rights into Manx law, following UK example
leads.detail: Cited in-text as Human Rights Act 2001

leads.title: Sexual Offences and Obscene Publications Act 2021
leads.documents: Pardons historical gay sex offences pre-1992 based on UK Alan Turing law 2017; 2020 amendment added ban on sexual orientation and gender identity conversion therapy, effective 2024
leads.detail: Cited in-text as passed July 2021 with royal assent, effective 1 July 2022 by proclamation; conversion therapy amendment added in Legislative Council in 2020

leads.title: Employment Act 2006 (c.21)
leads.documents: Made it unlawful to dismiss employees on grounds of sexual orientation; took effect 1 Sept 2006

leads.title: Civil Partnership Act 2011 (c.2)
leads.documents: Legalised civil partnerships from 6 April 2011 and granted equal access to full joint or stepchild adoption
leads.detail: Cited in-text as Civil Partnership Act 2011 (c. 2), signed 15 March 2011, took effect 6 April 2011

leads.title: Same-sex marriage legislation 2016
leads.documents: Repealed bar on same-sex marriage; legalised same-sex marriage effective 22 July 2016
leads.detail: Cited in-text as bill introduced to House of Keys 2 Feb 2016, passed House 8 March 17-3, Legislative Council 26 April 6-3, Royal assent 19 July 2016, effective 22 July 2016; public consultation and government response concluded 22 Jan 2016

leads.title: Sexual Offences (Amendment) Act 2006 (c.3)
leads.documents: Lowered age of consent to 16, gender-neutral for all sexual conduct regardless of gender and sexual orientation
leads.detail: Cited in-text as Sexual Offences (Amendment) Act 2006 (c.3)

leads.title: Sexual Offences Act 1992 - Sections 9 and 10
leads.documents: Retained criminalisation of buggery/gross indecency between men if under 16 or not in private; defines not in private; amended 2021 to delete more than two persons present and make public indecency language gender-neutral
leads.detail: Cited in-text as Sexual Offences Act 1992 Section 9 sub-sections (1) and (4) and Section 10

leads.title: Isle of Man Government hate crime bill community consultation - July 2022
leads.documents: Proposed hate crime bill explicitly including sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status and gender reassignment
leads.detail: Cited in-text as community consultation progressed July 2022
